name: API Design & Protocols
description: Designing and building robust, scalable backend APIs across multiple protocols (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), including contract specification (OpenAPI), payload validation, standardized error handling, pagination, versioning lifecycles, rate limiting, and API gateways.

subskills.name: RESTful Principles & Semantics
subskills.description: Resource-oriented URL design, correct HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), status code semantics, and idempotency.

subskills.name: Request Validation & Error Schemas
subskills.description: Incoming DTO/payload validation (Zod, Joi, class-validator, Pydantic), RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs, and centralized error middleware.

subskills.name: API Pagination & Filtering
subskills.description: Offset vs cursor-based pagination (keyset), sorting parameters, query filtering specifications, and payload metadata.

subskills.name: GraphQL APIs
subskills.description: Schema Definition Language (SDL), query and mutation resolvers, subscriptions over WebSockets, schema stitching, and DataLoader for N+1 batching.

subskills.name: gRPC & Protocol Buffers
subskills.description: Protocol Buffers (.proto) service definitions, unary vs streaming RPCs (client, server, bidirectional), and HTTP/2 transport benefits.

subskills.name: API Versioning & Deprecation
subskills.description: URI path versioning (/v1), header-based versioning (Accept header), query param versioning, backward compatibility, and deprecation headers.

subskills.name: OpenAPI / Swagger Contracts
subskills.description: OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract authoring, Swagger UI generation, contract-first development, and mock server generation from specs.

subskills.name: Rate Limiting & Throttling
subskills.description: Token bucket, leaky bucket, and sliding window rate limiting algorithms, Redis distributed rate limiters, and 429 Too Many Requests headers.

subskills.name: API Gateway & BFF Pattern
subskills.description: Reverse proxy routing, request aggregation, payload transformation, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architecture, Kong, Envoy, and AWS API Gateway.

subskills.name: Webhooks & Async APIs
subskills.description: Outbound webhook dispatching, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, exponential retry backoff, and dead-letter queue processing for failed deliveries.

junior.description: Designs RESTful endpoints with proper status codes, implements DTO validation, paginates queries, and writes OpenAPI documentation.

mid.description: Builds GraphQL schemas with DataLoader, defines gRPC Protobuf services, and manages API versioning lifecycles.

senior.description: Architects API Gateways (BFF pattern), designs distributed rate limiters, and builds reliable webhook dispatching systems with signature verification.
